title: 2018 Panini Prizm #59 Jonathan Stewart NFL Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2018 Panini Prizm sports trading card features Jonathan Stewart, a football player, with a card number of 59. It is a part of the Prizm parallel/variety and the base set. The card is from the modern period (1970-Now) and was manufactured by Panini Group. 

The near mint/mint condition of the card ensures that it is in top-notch quality. As a single product, it is a valuable addition to any sports trading card collection. Get your hands on this item today and add it to your collection!
